# Finishing touches {#sec-finishing-touches}

## DataTrail course project entries

Add your results from projects/Python Notebooks/Kaggle competitions completed during DataTrail to projects.html, along with any additional photos you can upload to images/ folder.

## Add a favicon

A favicon is the small icon in the browser tab. Save a square image to `images/` and add this inside the `<head>` of index.html:

```html
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="images/favicon.png">
```

## Keep customizing

Browse the font, icon, link underline options, and color sites from Chapter \@ref(home-page). For HTML, CSS, and JavaScript tutorials on features you'd like to add, I recommend Kevin Powell's videos.
